Run warmup CPU acceptance. It verifies last/best/initial, full binding,3465R/0T,phase5/update0,Adam/scheduler/T clocks,RNG,unchanged E0/SID,and full71657-row R5 beam32 output. Save stdout receipt.
Recompute budget using real warmup and first complete validation wall time and observed GPU utilization. Old16-hour caps are references only.

Check sustained GPU utilization against platform40pct/3h policy. Early startup-window averages are not conclusive. If sustained low, diagnose CPU/I/O bottlenecks or compliant scheduling before a long job; never add dummy GPU work or periodic restarts to evade reclamation.
Recheck exact Job names/output paths and live resource policy. Replace both placeholders per job; use dry-run then reviewed submit.

Runner performs original shared-warmup clone itself; do not manually edit/clone checkpoints. After both initial.pt exist for an architecture, run pair CPU acceptance and save receipt before claiming matched starts.

The pair check compares all serialized state except the arm tag against accepted warmup, including recommender,all tokenizer tensors/SID,optimizers,scheduler,RNG and progress. Runtime Mixer switch follows original CLI arm suffix.
Each branch adds30R/400T to shared5R; final cumulative24255R updates/400T per model.
No preflight weights, no data resplit, no source sync, no automatic retry; hard-stop recovery follows existing RECOVERY_AND_FINAL_AUDIT.md.
Release allocations promptly and charge actual allocation through pod deletion, including failures, against75GPUh.
